steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Astrophotography records images of celestial objects using cameras attached to telescopes or with standard cameras on tripods | Key Fact: Key camera settings: exposure time, ISO/gain, and aperture (f-number) | Key Fact: Star trails are created by long exposures showing the apparent rotation of the sky around the celestial pole | Key Fact: Image stacking combines multiple short exposures to reduce noise and reveal faint detail

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from astrophotography, and one past-paper question.
